comparisons.name: messages-field-light
comparisons.description: The capsule bezel: the empty message field of Messages with its placeholder, Aqua. The emoji button inside the field's trailing end is Messages' own artwork and is masked; the mask ends 1 pt before the capsule's edge, which stays in the score. The placeholder is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: messages-field-light-bezel
comparisons.description: As messages-field-light with the placeholder masked too, to score the capsule alone: its 24 pt height, round ends, 1 pt edge and fill.

comparisons.name: messages-field-dark
comparisons.description: The capsule bezel: the empty message field of Messages with its placeholder, Dark Aqua. The emoji button inside the field's trailing end is Messages' own artwork and is masked; the mask ends 1 pt before the capsule's edge, which stays in the score. The placeholder is set in the fallback font off Apple platforms.

comparisons.name: messages-field-dark-bezel
comparisons.description: As messages-field-dark with the placeholder masked too, to score the capsule alone: its 24 pt height, round ends, 1 pt edge and fill.
